## Summary

- [ ] Linked issue (or `N/A`)
- [ ] Summary of changes
- [ ] Theme contract change type: `additive` / `semantic change` /
      `breaking` / `N/A`

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix / patch
- [ ] New theme behavior or additive public hook/template support
- [ ] Semantic theme behavior or asset contract change
- [ ] Breaking theme contract change
- [ ] Documentation / config only
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (alias for `npm run validate`)
- [ ] Generated output in `spectre-theme/dist/` was regenerated via
      `npm run build` if package output changed
- [ ] No hardcoded visual values, local tokens, or client-specific branding
      introduced
- [ ] Theme version metadata stays synchronized where changed
- [ ] Tested in WordPress environment
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]` updated, or `N/A` is noted below
